 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Croatia hosts Czechia in their final Group fixture of the UEFA Nations League on Sunday at Opus Arena. Both sides will be aiming to finish their league-phase on a positive note, although their positions in the group have already been decided.
 Croatia have endured a difficult campaign, managing three points from five matches., including a 2-1 defeat to England in their previous fixture.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Czechia too have had a tough campaign, losing all five of their opening matches and are sitting at the bottom of the group without a point. They suffered a 2-0 defeat to Spain on November 12 in their last match.
 RIJEKA, CROATIA – 2026/10/03: Luka Modric (Croatia) seen in action during UEFA Nations League 2026 football match between Croatia vs England at HNK Rijeka Stadium (Rijeka).SOPA Images / Getty Images
 Spain and England have already secured the top two positions and advanced to the quarterfinals. 
 Croatia vs. Czechia Lineups
 Croatia expected lineup: 
 Livakovic; Smolčić, Stanisic, Vuskovic, Gvardiol; Modric, Kovačić; Sučić, Baturina, Vlasic; Matanovic 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Czech Republic expected lineup: 
 Kovar; Coufal, Zima, Vlcek, Jurásek; Král, Soucek; Ambros, Hlozek, Provod; Naderi
